name: research-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for research: literature search, claim checking, referee-style review and writing rules.

plugins.name: lit-search
plugins.description: Literature search on OpenAlex and arXiv that follows citations. A small model reads the top papers in full, and code checks every quote it returns against the paper.

plugins.name: writing-rules
plugins.description: Rules for papers, grant text and essays, with a lint for words that tell the reader how to feel. The lint runs after every write to a .tex or .md file.

plugins.name: reviewers
plugins.description: Two or three reviewer agents read research in progress or a draft and give every item a verdict such as fix, develop or cut. A hook checks every quote they cite.

plugins.name: checker
plugins.description: A checker agent tests claims, numbers and captions against the files they came from. Each objection quotes a file and line, and a hook checks the quote.
